newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brother of ex-French president in fraud probe.
newsitem.headline: Brother of ex-French president in fraud probe.

text.p: French businessman Olivier Giscard d'Estaing, brother of former President Valery Giscard d'Estaing, is under investigation for a suspected fraud involving 15 million francs ($3 million), judicial sources said on Wednesday.
The sources were confirming a report published by the weekly news magazine VSD which said the ex-president's brother was among 18 people placed under investigation in the case.
One of the others is Jean Domanage, former president of the French National Builders Federation, the sources said.
The case revolves around illegal commissions paid into a Swiss bank account during the renovation of a luxury hotel next to the former palace of France's kings at Versailles near Paris.
The ultimate beneficiary of the payments has not been identified. Several recent similar cases have involved the illegal financing of French political parties.
